articles.title_en: Clean Identification? The Effects of the Clean Air Act on Air Pollution, Exposure Disparities, and House Prices
articles.title_cn: 清洁识别？《清洁空气法》对空气污染、暴露差异和房价的影响
articles.abstract_en: We assess the US Clean Air Act standards for fine particulate matter (PM 2.5 ). Using high-resolution data, we find that the 2005 regulation reduced PM 2.5 levels by 0.4 μg/m 3 over five years, with larger effects in more polluted areas. Standard difference-in-differences overstates these effects by a factor of three because time trends differ by baseline pollution, a bias we overcome with three alternative approaches. We show that the regulation contributed to narrowing Urban-Rural and Black-White PM 2.5 exposure disparities, but less than difference-in-differences suggest. Pollution damages capitalized into house prices, however, appear larger than previously thought when leveraging regulatory variation. (JEL D63, K32, Q52, Q53, Q58, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了美国《清洁空气法》对细颗粒物（PM 2.5）的标准。利用高分辨率数据，我们发现 2005 年的法规在五年内将 PM 2.5 水平降低了 0.4 μg/m 3，且在污染更严重的地区效果更大。标准双重差分法将这些效果高估了三倍，因为时间趋势随基线污染水平而异，我们通过三种替代方法克服了这一偏差。我们表明，该法规有助于缩小城乡和黑人-白人之间的 PM 2.5 暴露差异，但程度低于双重差分法所暗示的。然而，当利用监管变化时，资本化到房价中的污染损害似乎比先前认为的更大。（JEL D63, K32, Q52, Q53, Q58, R31）

articles.title_en: Uncharted Waters: Effects of Maritime Emission Regulation
articles.title_cn: 未知水域：海上排放法规的影响
articles.abstract_en: Maritime shipping emits as much fine particulate matter as half of global road traffic. We are the first to measure the consequences of US maritime emissions standards on air quality, human health, racial exposure disparities, and behavior. The introduction of US maritime emissions control areas significantly decreased fine particulate matter, low birth weight, and infant mortality. Yet, only about half of the forecasted fine particulate matter abatement was achieved by the policy. We show evidence consistent with behavioral responses among ship operators, other polluters, and individuals that muted the policy’s impact, but were not incorporated in ex ante models. (JEL I12, L92, Q51, Q52, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 海上航运排放的细颗粒物相当于全球道路交通排放总量的一半。我们首次衡量了美国海上排放标准对空气质量、人类健康、种族暴露差异及行为的影响。美国海上排放控制区的引入显著降低了细颗粒物、低出生体重和婴儿死亡率。然而，该政策仅实现了预测细颗粒物减排量的大约一半。我们提供的证据与船舶运营商、其他污染者及个体的行为反应一致，这些反应削弱了政策的影响，但未纳入事前模型。(JEL I12, L92, Q51, Q52, Q53, Q58)

articles.title_en: Mental Health Consequences of Correctional Sentencing
articles.title_cn: 矫正判决的心理健康后果
articles.abstract_en: Understanding whether and in what situations correctional sentencing improves or exacerbates defendants’ mental health conditions is important for the design of criminal justice policies. We combine detailed Norwegian data on visits to health care professionals with quasi-experimental designs to measure the impacts of correctional sentences on mental health-related visits. Our causal evidence shows that rehabilitation-oriented sentencing can improve defendants’ mental health conditions. We find that these effects are persistent and unlikely driven by shifts in health care demand. We interpret these findings in light of the rehabilitative focus of the Norwegian correctional system. (JEL I12, I18, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 理解矫正判决在何种情况下以及如何改善或恶化被告的心理健康状况，对于刑事司法政策的设计至关重要。我们结合挪威详细的医疗专业人员访问数据与准实验设计，来衡量矫正判决对心理健康相关访问的影响。我们的因果证据表明，以康复为导向的判决可以改善被告的心理健康状况。我们发现这些效应是持久的，且不太可能由医疗需求的变化所驱动。我们结合挪威矫正系统的康复重点来解释这些发现。（JEL I12, I18, K42）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Provider Payments on Health Care Utilization of Low-Income Individuals: Evidence from Medicare and Medicaid
articles.title_cn: 提供者支付对低收入个体医疗利用的影响：来自医疗保险和医疗补助的证据
articles.abstract_en: Provider payments are the key determinant of insurance generosity within many health insurance programs covering low-income populations. This paper analyzes a large, federally mandated provider payment increase for primary care services provided to low-income elderly and disabled individuals. Using comprehensive administrative data, we leverage variation across beneficiaries and providers in the policy-induced payment increase in difference-in-differences and triple differences research designs. We find the payment increase led to a 6 percent increase in the targeted services for eligible beneficiaries, implying a payment elasticity of 1.2, and decreased the fraction of low-income beneficiaries with no primary care visit in a year by 9 percent. (JEL G22, I11, I13, I18, I38)
articles.abstract_cn: 提供者支付是许多覆盖低收入人群的健康保险计划中保险慷慨程度的关键决定因素。本文分析了一项由联邦政府强制实施的大型提供者支付增加，针对低收入老年人和残疾人的初级保健服务。利用全面的行政数据，我们利用受益人和提供者在政策引发的支付增加中的差异，采用双重差分和三重差分研究设计。我们发现，支付增加导致符合条件的受益人的目标服务使用量增加了6%，这意味着支付弹性为1.2，并且使低收入受益人中一年内没有初级保健就诊的比例下降了9%。（JEL G22, I11, I13, I18, I38）

articles.title_en: Spillover, Efficiency, and Equity Effects of Regional Firm Subsidies
articles.title_cn: 区域企业补贴的溢出、效率与公平效应
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effects of a large place-based policy, subsidizing up to 50 percent of the investment costs of East German manufacturing plants. We show that a 1 percentage point decrease in subsidy rate leads to a 1 percent decrease in manufacturing employment. We document important local spillovers for the untreated construction and retail sectors, counties connected via trade, and local tax rates. There is no evidence for regional reallocation, within-firm spillover, or changes in commuting and residential decisions. The cost per job amounts to about $19,000. We show local subsidies are substantially more effective in curbing regional inequality than place-blind policies. (JEL G31, H71, L60, L74, L81, R23, R51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一项大型地域导向政策的效果，该政策为东德制造业工厂的投资成本提供高达50%的补贴。我们表明，补贴率每降低1个百分点，会导致制造业就业减少1%。我们记录了未受补贴的建筑业和零售业、通过贸易连接的县以及地方税率的重要本地溢出效应。没有证据表明存在区域重新配置、企业内溢出或通勤和居住决策的变化。每个工作岗位的成本约为19,000美元。我们表明，地方补贴在抑制区域不平等方面比无地域针对性的政策更为有效。(JEL G31, H71, L60, L74, L81, R23, R51)

articles.title_en: Policymaking, Trust, and the Demand for Public Services: Evidence from a Mass Sterilization Campaign
articles.title_cn: 政策制定、信任与公共服务需求：来自大规模绝育运动的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study a large-scale family planning intervention in which more than 260,000 Peruvian women were sterilized. Many of these medical procedures are alleged to have been performed without patient consent. The subsequent disclosure of alleged illegal sterilizations caused reductions in the usage of contraceptive methods and prenatal and birth delivery services and, more generally, the demand for medical services in affected areas. As a result, child health worsened. The results persist for at least 17 years after the information disclosure and are driven by disappointed supporters of the implementing government. Learning about the government’s malpractices undermined trust in institutions. (JEL I12, I18, I38, J13, J16, J18, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项大规模计划生育干预措施，其中超过260,000名秘鲁妇女被绝育。据称，这些医疗程序中有许多是在未经患者同意的情况下进行的。随后披露的涉嫌非法绝育事件导致受影响地区避孕方法的使用以及产前和分娩服务的使用减少，更广泛地说，医疗服务的需求下降。结果，儿童健康状况恶化。这些影响在信息披露后至少持续17年，并且由对实施政府失望的支持者所驱动。了解政府的不当行为削弱了对制度的信任。(JEL I12, I18, I38, J13, J16, J18, O15)

articles.title_en: The Great Recession and the Widening Income Gap between Alumni of Elite and Less Selective Universities
articles.title_cn: 大衰退与精英大学及非精英大学毕业生收入差距的扩大
articles.abstract_en: Using mobility report card data, I show the income gap between alumni of elite and less selective universities widened for cohorts graduating during the Great Recession. This is evident for mean and median incomes and access to high earning percentiles. Results do not appear driven by differences in student composition, including parental income. Using a unique dataset of recruiting strategies for prestigious firms, I highlight one channel through which university selectivity may have a causal impact: high-wage firms concentrated their recruiting at elite universities during the recession. The results are informative for policies increasing lower-income students’ representation at selective universities. (JEL D31, E32, I23, I28, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用流动性报告卡数据，我展示了在大衰退期间毕业的群体中，精英大学与非精英大学毕业生之间的收入差距有所扩大。这在平均收入和中位收入以及进入高收入百分位的机会方面均表现明显。结果似乎并非由学生构成（包括父母收入）的差异所驱动。利用一份针对知名企业招聘策略的独特数据集，我强调了大学选择性可能产生因果影响的一个渠道：在经济衰退期间，高薪企业将招聘集中在精英大学。这些结果对于增加低收入学生在选择性大学中代表性的政策具有参考意义。(JEL D31, E32, I23, I28, J31)

articles.title_en: Electronic Payment Technology and Tax Compliance: Evidence from Uruguay’s Financial Inclusion Reform
articles.title_cn: 电子支付技术与税收遵从：来自乌拉圭金融包容性改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: Does the digitization of transactions in an economy increase tax compliance? We study the effect of financial incentives on the adoption of electronic payment technology and on tax compliance by firms. Exploiting administrative data and policy variation from Uruguay, we show that (i) consumer VAT rebates for credit and debit transactions trigger an immediate 50 percent increase in the number of card transactions, (ii) firms’ use of card machines increases only on the intensive margin, and (iii) tax compliance is unaffected. Endogenous card machine adoption and a low share of card sales in total reported sales can rationalize the findings. (JEL E42, H25, H26, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 经济中交易的数字化是否会提高税收遵从？我们研究了金融激励对电子支付技术采用及企业税收遵从的影响。利用乌拉圭的行政数据和政策变化，我们表明：（i）针对信用卡和借记卡交易的消费者增值税退税立即导致卡交易数量增加50%；（ii）企业使用刷卡机的行为仅在集约边际上增加；（iii）税收遵从未受影响。内生性的刷卡机采用以及卡销售在总报告销售中占比较低可以合理解释这些发现。（JEL E42, H25, H26, O16）

articles.title_en: My Taxes Are Too Darn High: Why Do Households Protest Their Taxes?
articles.title_cn: 我的税太高了：家庭为何抗议其税收？
articles.abstract_en: In the United States and globally, taxpayers can file a protest to legally reduce their property taxes. While tax protests can provide a unique opportunity to study the (un)willingness to pay taxes, they have received little attention from researchers. Using a field experiment and a quasi-experiment, we study what motivates households to protest their property taxes. We find that both expected savings and filing frictions play significant roles. We estimate the magnitude of filing frictions using a money metric. We also discuss how low-cost interventions targeted at disadvantaged groups can mitigate existing disparities in the system of tax appeals. (JEL C93, D91, G51, H71)
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国及全球范围内，纳税人可以提出抗议以合法减少其房产税。虽然税收抗议为研究纳税意愿（或不愿纳税）提供了独特机会，但研究者对此关注甚少。通过一项实地实验和一项准实验，我们研究了促使家庭抗议其房产税的因素。我们发现，预期节省和申请摩擦均发挥重要作用。我们使用货币度量来估计申请摩擦的大小。我们还讨论了针对弱势群体的低成本干预措施如何能够缓解税收申诉体系中现有的不平等现象。(JEL C93, D91, G51, H71)

articles.title_en: Fighting Poverty One Family at a Time: Experimental Evidence from an Intervention with Holistic, Individualized, Wraparound Services
articles.title_cn: 逐户扶贫：一项综合、个性化、全方位服务干预的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Families in poverty face numerous barriers to establishing stable economic footing. This paper estimates experimental effects of a holistic, individualized wraparound service intervention for low-income individuals. The intervention includes a detailed assessment, an individualized service plan, intensive case management administered by a two-person team with small caseloads, and strategic financial assistance. The program improved employment and housing outcomes two years postenrollment. Given the customized nature of the services, overall program effects mask heterogeneity. Exploratory analysis suggests that the program helped employ participants who lacked employment but had stable housing and that those without stable housing were helped in securing it. (JEL I32, I38, L31, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 贫困家庭在建立稳定经济基础方面面临众多障碍。本文估计了一项针对低收入个体的综合、个性化全方位服务干预的实验效应。该干预包括详细评估、个性化服务计划、由两人小组管理且案件量较小的密集案件管理，以及战略性财政援助。该计划在入组后两年改善了就业和住房结果。鉴于服务的定制性质，总体计划效应掩盖了异质性。探索性分析表明，该计划帮助了缺乏就业但住房稳定的参与者实现就业，并帮助了住房不稳定者获得稳定住房。（JEL I32, I38, L31, R23）

articles.title_en: Fueling Alternatives: Gas Station Choice and the Implications for Electric Charging
articles.title_cn: 替代燃料：加油站选择及其对电动汽车充电的启示
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the value of electric vehicle (EV) charging networks and the marginal value of network speed and density. We estimate a model of gasoline drivers’ refueling preferences and simulate how these potential future EV drivers value refueling time under counterfactual charging networks. Drivers value refueling time at $19.73/hour. EV adopters with home charging receive $675 per vehicle in benefits from avoiding travel to gas stations, whereas refueling travel and waiting time costs $7,763 for drivers using public charging. Increasing network charging speed yields three times greater time savings than a proportional increase in station density. (JEL D12, H54, Q42, Q58, R41)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了电动汽车（EV）充电网络的价值以及网络速度和密度的边际价值。我们估计了一个关于汽油驾驶者加油偏好的模型，并模拟了这些潜在未来电动汽车驾驶者在反事实充电网络下如何评价加油时间。驾驶者对加油时间的价值评估为每小时19.73美元。拥有家庭充电设施的电动汽车采用者因避免前往加油站而获得每辆车675美元的收益，而使用公共充电的驾驶者则需承担7,763美元的加油出行和等待时间成本。提高网络充电速度所带来的时间节省是站点密度按比例增加的三倍。（JEL D12, H54, Q42, Q58, R41）

articles.title_en: The Long-Run Effects of California’s Paid Family Leave Act on Women’s Careers and Childbearing: New Evidence from a Regression Discontinuity Design and US Tax Data
articles.title_cn: 加州带薪家庭休假法案对女性职业与生育的长期影响：基于断点回归设计与美国税收数据的新证据
articles.abstract_en: We use administrative tax data to analyze the cumulative, long-run effects of California’s 2004 Paid Family Leave Act (CPFL) on women’s employment, earnings, and childbearing. A regression-discontinuity design exploits the sharp increase in the weeks of paid leave available under the law. We find no evidence that CPFL increased employment, boosted earnings, or encouraged childbearing, suggesting that CPFL had little effect on the gender pay gap or child penalty. For first-time mothers, we find that CPFL reduced employment and earnings a decade after they gave birth. (JEL H24, J13, J16, J31, J32, K31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用行政税收数据分析加州2004年带薪家庭休假法案（CPFL）对女性就业、收入和生育的累积长期影响。断点回归设计利用了该法律下带薪休假周数的急剧增加。我们没有发现CPFL提高就业、增加收入或鼓励生育的证据，表明CPFL对性别薪酬差距或生育惩罚影响甚微。对于首次生育的母亲，我们发现CPFL在她们生育十年后降低了就业和收入。(JEL H24, J13, J16, J31, J32, K31)

articles.title_en: Profit Taxation, R&D Spending, and Innovation
articles.title_cn: 利润税、研发支出与创新
articles.abstract_en: We study how profit taxes affect establishments’ R&D activities. Relying on detailed panel data of R&D-active firms in Germany over two decades, we exploit identifying variation induced by more than 10,000 municipal changes in the local business tax rate and federal tax reforms with locally varying effects. Using event-study techniques, we find a sizable, negative effect of profit taxes on establishments’ total R&D spending and patents filed. Zooming into the innovation production process, we uncover substantial heterogeneity in the impact of profit taxation for various R&D input factors, among firm characteristics, and for different types of research projects. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, H71, O31, O34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了利润税如何影响企业的研发活动。基于德国两十年间研发活跃企业的详细面板数据，我们利用由超过10,000个地方营业税税率变化和具有地方性差异效应的联邦税收改革所引发的识别变异。采用事件研究方法，我们发现利润税对企业总研发支出和专利申请有显著的负面影响。深入创新生产过程，我们揭示了利润税对各种研发投入要素、企业特征以及不同类型研究项目影响的显著异质性。(JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, H71, O31, O34)

articles.title_en: Who Bears the Burden of Local Taxes?
articles.title_cn: 地方税的负担由谁承担？
articles.abstract_en: We study the distributional effects of local taxes. They turn out to be strikingly progressive. We calibrate a municipality-level structural model with quasi-experimental estimates of taxpayer mobilty by family type. Households with children are found to be less mobile than households without children and to have stronger preferences for locally provided public goods. Combined with capitalization of taxes into housing prices and nonhomothetic housing demand, this implies that the incidence of local income taxes mainly falls on high-income childless households. Increases in local income taxes, even if flat rate, turn out to be more progressive than property taxes. (JEL H22, H71, R21, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了地方税的收入分配效应。结果发现，这些税收具有显著的累进性。我们校准了一个市级结构模型，其中使用了按家庭类型划分的纳税人流动性的准实验估计。研究发现，有子女的家庭比无子女家庭的流动性更低，并且对本地提供的公共物品有更强的偏好。结合税收资本化到房价以及非齐次住房需求，这意味着地方所得税的负担主要落在高收入无子女家庭身上。即使地方所得税是统一税率，其增加也被证明比财产税更具累进性。(JEL H22, H71, R21, R31)

articles.title_en: The Negative Consequences of Loss-Framed Performance Incentives
articles.title_cn: 损失框架绩效激励的负面后果
articles.abstract_en: Behavioral economists have proposed that incentive contracts result in higher productivity when bonuses are “loss framed”—prepaid then clawed back if targets are unmet. We test this claim by randomizing the pre- or postpayment of sales bonuses at 294 car dealerships. Although somewhat statistically imprecise, our analysis provides strong indications that the random assignment of loss framing had quantitatively important negative effects. We document that the negative effects of loss framing can arise due to an increase in incentives for “gaming” behaviors. Based on these claims, we reassess the common wisdom regarding the desirability of loss framing. (JEL C93, D91, J24, J33, L62, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 行为经济学家提出，当奖金采用“损失框架”——即预先支付，若未达到目标则收回——时，激励合同能带来更高的生产率。我们通过在294家汽车经销商中随机分配销售奖金的预付或后付方式来检验这一论断。尽管统计上有些不精确，但我们的分析强烈表明，随机分配的损失框架产生了数量上重要的负面效应。我们记录了损失框架的负面效应可能源于“博弈”行为激励的增加。基于这些发现，我们重新评估了关于损失框架可取性的普遍观点。(JEL C93, D91, J24, J33, L62, L81)

articles.title_en: Effective Health Aid: Evidence from Gavi’s Vaccine Program
articles.title_cn: 有效卫生援助：来自Gavi疫苗项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance has provided over US$16 billion in funding for vaccination in low- and middle-income countries since 1999. We exploit differential timing across countries and vaccines to estimate the effects of this public health initiative. We find that Gavi’s support for a vaccine increased coverage rates by 2–5 percentage points across all vaccines and by 10–20 percentage points for newer vaccines. We also find that Gavi’s support reduced child mortality from related causes by 1 child per 1,000 live births. We estimate these improvements saved around 1.5 million lives at a cost of about US$9,000 per life saved. (JEL F35, F53, I12, I15, I18, J13, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 自16年以来，疫苗联盟Gavi已为低收入和中等收入国家的疫苗接种提供了超过1999亿美元的资金。我们利用不同国家和疫苗之间的时间差异来评估这一公共卫生倡议的效果。我们发现，Gavi对一种疫苗的支持使所有疫苗的覆盖率提高了2-5个百分点，对新疫苗的覆盖率提高了10-20个百分点。我们还发现，Gavi的支持使相关原因导致的儿童死亡率每1例活产减少了1,000例。我们估计这些改善挽救了约1.5万人的生命，每挽救一条生命的成本约为9,000美元。(JEL F35, F53, I12, I15, I18, J13, O15)
